tax_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) / ضريبة القيمة المضافة
legal_ref: VAT Law promulgated by Royal Decree No. 121/2020, Art. 36; Royal Decree Art. Four (in force 180 days after publication)
quote: Article (36): Subject to the provisions in articles (51, 52, and 53) of this Law, the Tax on the import and supply of taxable Goods or Services shall be computed as (5%) five percent of the Taxable Value. Royal Decree Art. Four: “…shall come into force after (180) one hundred and eighty days from the date of publication.” (Tax Authority English translation; Arabic prevails)
source_title: Oman Tax Authority – Value Added Tax Law (Royal Decree 121/2020), English translation
notes: Single standard rate 5%; zero rate (Arts. 51-53 and Chairman decisions) on exports, international transport, specified basic food items (Decisions 65/2021, 89/2022, 225/2026), medicines and medical equipment (Decisions 223/2026, 224/2026), investment metals, crude oil/gas, etc. Exempt: financial services, healthcare, education, bare land, resale of residential property, local passenger transport, residential rent. Executive Regulations: Decision 53/2021, amended by 456/2022, 521/2023, 81/2025. Royal Decree issued 12 Oct 2020; commencement 180 days after Official Gazette publication.
